generation.scope: Complete classification of the three-axis companion family. Regularity is equivalent to Delta=sum(a_i^2 a_j^2) nonzero; the rank-ten torus gives a two-dimensional image and exactly two active axes give bisymmetric rank eight. Every unmarked indexed isomorphism class is specified by the unordered projective triple of coefficient squares, including the positive-dimensional point-scheme boundary.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed ternary-word reductions, generic degreewise flatness, the polynomial-module dimension squeeze, depth-two dual exactness, singular-root exclusion, and marked/unmarked orbit reconstruction on the finite, line and rank-eight boundaries.

mathematical_computation.scope: Symbolic flat identities, all four opposite blocks, signed quadratic normalizers and quartic Pfaffian over Q(a,b,c), plus explicit trisecant counts.

tex.scope: Main 170 pages, plan 6 and notes 13, clean final logs.

open_mathematics: Classify arbitrary Klein-four homogeneous singly symmetric windows with a marked simple fixed point. Separate adjoint and skew-adjoint axial triples by the flatness equations; handle vanishing coefficients and then determine what can happen when marked axes are not transverse.
